content: Ibraimore ḍaker edde duwa gorer
Mabude Ibraimore hodde, "Tui tor nizor deš, tor egena gušti edde tor bafor gór sari, ãi ze dešot tore dehaiyum tui heṛe za.

content.text: edde tui oinno zonolla rahamot oibi.
Zara tore duwa goribo, ãi hitarare duwa goriyum,
ar zara tore bodduwa dibo, ãi hitarare bodduwa diyum.

content: Toi Mabude hoiyede mozin Ibraime baisa diye, ar Lut o hibar fũwati giye. Harranottu niyoli zargoide šomot Ibraimor boyoš oilde hoittor fãs bosor.
Ibraime hibar bou Saraire edde báiyor fut Lutore, ar hitara Harranot ze dón šombotti hamail, ze gulam okkol fail, hin beggun loiyore Kenan dešot zaibolla baisa diye, toi hitara Kenanot fõisse.
Ar Ibraime deš bai zaite Šekimot he Paki zaga Mure-elun gas foijjonto giye. Hẽtte Kenaniyo okkol he dešot aššil.
Tarfore Mabude Ibraimore deha diye edde hibare hodde, "Ei dešgan ãi tor bongšore diyum." Toi Ibraime hibare deha diyede he Mabudor mutallek heṛe ekkan kurbangah tiyar goijje.

Bade hibaye hentu Betelor fuke fahari elehat agguwai zaiyore fosimottu Betel ar fukottu Ai šohoror maza mazi ek zagat hibar ṭambu gãijje. Heṛe hibaye Mabudor mutallek ekkan kurbangah tiyar goijje edde Mabudor name ḍaikke.
Tarfore Ibraime hentu baisa diyore doine Negevor mikka zat roiye.
Mišorot Ibraimor baisa
Bade dešot ek raṭ oiye, toi Ibraime lamat Mišorot forbaš goribolla baisa diye; kiyollahoile Kenan dešot koṭin raṭ oil.
Ar Ibraim zehon Mišoror hãsa haši aišše, hibaye hibar bou Saraire hodde, "Sa, ãi zani, tui kub šundori.
Tore zẽtte Mišoriyo okkole dekibo, hitara hoibo, 'Iba itar bou.' Toi hitara tore zinda rakibo kintu ãre mari felaibo.
Hetolla hitarare endilla hois ze, tui ãr boin, toi zene tor hatire hitara ãr loi bala bebohar gore, ar tor zoriya ãr foran basi zagoi."
Ibraim zehon Mišorot góille Mišoriyo okkole deikke ze Sarai kub šundori.
Feruwanor ofisar okkole hibare dekiyore hitara Feruwanor hãse hibar tarif goijje; toi hibare raz moholot loi za oiye.
Ar hibar hatire hite Ibraim loi bala bebohar goijje, ar henot hibaye bout sool, goru, gada, gadi, uṭ edde gulam edde bandi okkol faiye.
Kintu Ibraimor bou, Sarailla boli Mabude Feruwan edde hitar foribaror uwore koṭin bola okkol goṭaiye.
Toi Feruwane Ibraimore ḍaki ainne edde hodde, "Tũi ãr loi endilla ka goijjio? Hiba tũwar boude hiyan tũi ãre kiyolla no ho?
Tũi 'Iba ãr boin' kiyolla hoiyo, toi ãi hibare biya goribolla loi annilam? So, doro tũwar bou, hibare lo edde zogoi!"
Bade Feruwane hitar manuš okkolore Ibraimor babute hokum diye, ar hitara Ibraimor šombotti šoho, hibare edde hibar bouwore bidai diye.
